mapper.sql: r.id, r.bill_no AS billNo, r.material_id AS materialId, r.batch_no AS batchNo, r.in_num AS inNum, r.in_user AS inUser, r.in_time AS inTime, r.create_time AS createTime, m.material_code AS materialCode, m.material_name AS materialName, m.location_no AS locationNo
mapper.select: select from in_record r left join tb_material m on r.material_id = m.id where r.in_time >= CONCAT(#{start}, ' 00:00:00') and r.in_time <= CONCAT(#{end}, ' 23:59:59') order by r.in_time desc

select from in_record r left join tb_material m on r.material_id = m.id
AND r.in_time >= CONCAT(#{start}, ' 00:00:00') AND r.in_time <= CONCAT(#{end}, ' 23:59:59')
AND r.bill_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{billNo}, '%')
AND ( r.bill_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR r.batch_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR m.material_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR m.material_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
ORDER BY r.in_time DESC
